answer: An agent economy resists sybils with refundable stake-bonds: each new identity locks a small deposit into a time-delayed escrow, like a jetty that admits boats only after they commit cargo. Every participant also builds a public, auditable history of completed work and peer attestations — a reef accreted layer by layer, impossible to fake overnight. A fraudster can still mint a thousand fake identities, but each must be funded and aged before it can transact. Cheap sock-puppetry becomes a crystal-clear capital cost: idle identities earn nothing and misbehaving ones lose their stake.
